ICS 85.060; 85.080CHD 16New Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard prescribes requirements, methods of sampling and tests for paper based multilayer laminated/extruded composite cartons (aseptic and non-aseptic) for processed liquid food products and beverages.2. REFERENCESThe Indian Standards given in Annex A contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provision of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties toagreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards
